Also `slugify("--a--b--")` should give `"a-b"`.

Perfect! I can see the issue. The current implementation:
1. Converts non-alphanumeric characters to hyphens, which creates multiple consecutive hyphens
2. Doesn't remove leading/trailing hyphens

The fix needs to:
1. Replace consecutive hyphens with a single hyphen
2. Remove leading and trailing hyphens

arguments.new:
def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Turn arbitrary text into a URL slug: lowercase, ASCII letters and
    digits, words separated by single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens."""
    text = text.lower()
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)
    text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)  # Replace multiple hyphens with single hyphen
    text = text.strip("-")  # Remove leading and trailing hyphens
    return text
